## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what's getting in the way today? (A concrete
use case is more useful than an abstract one.)

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see added or changed? If you have an idea of the
API shape, sketch it out.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — links, prior art in other mediator libraries, etc.
